name: new_xsum_benchmark
description: A benchmarking dataset derived from the XSum summarization task intended to evaluate abstractive summarization quality and robustness on news articles. It is used to measure models' ability to produce concise, informative summaries and may include checks for factual consistency and fluency beyond n-gram overlap. Evaluation commonly pairs automatic metrics with human judgments for best insight.
reputation: A niche variant of the popular XSum benchmark with limited adoption compared to the canonical XSum split; used for more targeted robustness/quality checks.
